paragraphs: Mentioned in [Yevamot 98a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.98a.6) (Hyman cites 98b). [1] Ben Yasiyin said, ‘When I went to the coastal cities, I found a certain convert—I said to him, “My son, who permitted you?” He replied, “On this bench R' Akiva sat and said, etc.”’[^3]

notes.text: The consulted passage is on Yevamot 98a, while Hyman prints 98b. It concerns permission to marry a maternal brother’s wife, not permission to convert. Hyman omits that detail; the English removes the incorrect conversion gloss without inserting an unquoted clause. The marker [1] remains.
The supplied [1] and the closing “etc.” are preserved. The text does not establish the contents of the missing reference or an identity for Ben Yasiyin beyond the named speaker.

The linked account names Ben Yasiyin and gives the question as permission to marry the former wife of a maternal brother. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=738&lang=en) cites 98a and preserves the bench detail. The mark near the name in Hyman’s print does not establish the contents of the supplied [1].
